title: Move Table Rows or Columns (Tables)

scenarios.title: Move Table Rows or Columns applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Move Table Rows or Columns (BtnMoveTableRowColumn) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: BtnMoveTableRowColumn deterministic Office leg

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Move Row Down command applied to a fixture 3x3 table with row 2 selected swaps row 2 with row 3 (text order r1, r3, r2) while the dimensions and all other rows stay untouched, the feature reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Move Row Down command applied to a fixture 3x3 table with row 2 selected swaps row 2 with row 3 (text order r1, r3, r2) while the dimensions and all other rows stay untouched, the feature reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.

scenarios.title: BtnMoveTableRowColumn column-move deterministic Office leg

requirements.text: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Move Column Right command applied to a fixture 3x3 table with cell (2,2) selected swaps column 2 with column 3 (the texts r1c3, r2c3, r3c3 move into column 2 and r1c2, r2c2, r3c2 into column 3) while the dimensions and all other rows stay untouched, the feature reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Move Column Right command applied to a fixture 3x3 table with cell (2,2) selected swaps column 2 with column 3 (the texts r1c3, r2c3, r3c3 move into column 2 and r1c2, r2c2, r3c2 into column 3) while the dimensions and all other rows stay untouched, the feature reports execution, writes no new error-log entry, and tears down cleanly.

done.statement: The deterministic Office leg passes against the configured build on an isolated PowerPoint host with zero new error-log entries and full teardown; bind-office-evidence-and-reviews remains until this office scenario has real-host evidence and review.
